skill_name: Identify a few ways technology can make learning easier.
workflow: Technology can make learning easier in a variety of ways. For example, online courses provide convenience and flexibility. They can be accessed from anywhere, anytime, meaning students no longer have to be physically present in a classroom to gain knowledge. Similarly, interactive websites, apps and tutorials can make language learning a more engaging experience.
